title: Dash Shooters
description:
Dash Shooters is a multiplayer, fast paced racing game, where the main movement mechanic is dashing! Race your friends to the finish line through a randomly generated map, dodging obstacles, gathering powerups, shooting crystals/other players, and dashing through objectives along the way! There are also in game settings to change the style of play, so there can be countless hours of fun! :)





Features:

-Fast paced movement

-Multiplayer for up to 6 players

-Four unique powerups

-Combat (can be turned on and off)

-Randomly generated maps, with different difficulties

-Objectives to dash through

-Crystals to shoot (great for practicing aim)

-High skill ceiling

-In game settings to change the style of play

-And much more :)
